content.text: The admin web UI lives in
web/admin/
and calls the service's REST API. It holds no stock logic of its own and never talks to the database directly.

ai.stableNodeKey: Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › Client and presentation ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › API and orchestration ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase~9e6a3843~tory service: a tour of the codebase › Observability and error handling § text#0

content.text: The HTTP handlers in
src/api/routes.ts
are the only entry point for requests. They validate the request body, attach a correlation ID, and pass the work on, containing no business rules.

ai.stableNodeKey: Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › Client and presentation ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › API and orchestration ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase~9d6a36b0~tory service: a tour of the codebase › Observability and error handling § text#1

content.text: The reservation orchestrator in
src/orders/reserve.ts
coordinates reservations. It asks the stock ledger to reserve the quantity and pricing rules for the price. Once both succeed, it publishes a
StockReserved
event. If the ledger cannot reserve the full quantity, the orchestrator rejects the whole order, never making a partial reservation. Reservations not confirmed within 15 minutes are released.

content.text: The stock ledger in
src/ledger/ledger.ts
owns stock levels, recording changes as append-only ledger entries (reserve, release, restock) to Postgres. It is the only module allowed to write to stock tables.

ai.stableNodeKey: Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › Client and presentation ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › API and orchestration ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase~9f6a39d6~tory service: a tour of the codebase › Observability and error handling § text#3

content.text: The pricing rules in
src/pricing/rules.ts
calculate order prices from supplier price lists and discounts. They read price lists from Redis, cached for 300 seconds, and never change stock.

ai.stableNodeKey: Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › Client and presentation ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › API and orchestration ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase~a26a3e8f~tory service: a tour of the codebase › Observability and error handling § text#4

content.text: The supplier feed adapter in
src/suppliers/feedAdapter.ts

brings in restocks. It calls the supplier API every 10 minutes, converts deliveries to restocks, and asks the stock ledger to record them. It is the only module aware of the supplier's data format. Unparsable deliveries are logged and skipped, not retried.

content.text: Postgres holds ledger entries and current stock levels, serving as the source of truth for stock. Schema changes are in
db/migrations/
and run on every deploy.

content.text: Every module logs through the structured logger in

content.text: The retry helper in
src/platform/retry.ts

wraps calls to the supplier API. The retry policy includes at most 5 attempts per delivery, exponential backoff starting at 2 seconds and capped at 60 seconds. After the 5th failed attempt, the delivery is published to the dead-letter queue
inventory.dlq
on the message broker, and staff review it in the admin UI. Retries apply only to supplier calls; failed reservations are returned as errors.

ai.stableNodeKey: Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › Client and presentation ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › API and orchestration ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase~4f33cd13~ory service: a tour of the codebase › Observability and error handling § text#11

content.text: The codebase is structured into client, API/orchestration, domain services, supplier integration, persistence, and observability layers. Dependencies flow inwards, with the API calling orchestrators, and orchestrators calling domain modules. Domain modules only depend on persistence and platform helpers.

ai.stableNodeKey: Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › Client and presentation ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase › API and orchestration ⨁ Shelfwise inventory service: a tour of the codebase~5033cea6~ory service: a tour of the codebase › Observability and error handling § text#12

content.text: The Admin UI interacts with the API, which orchestrates reservations by consulting the stock ledger and pricing rules. The supplier feed adapter integrates with the supplier API, using a retry mechanism and logging. All modules use a structured logger for consistent error tracking.
